answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 78 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is published against the violet challenge, the wharf audit can replay the sonnet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1037 identities would post 4745 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
